results.statement: On a sanity PASS the sanity side must link the checked PR as the new top of the phase stack before the close hook runs; when the checked head does not descend from the recorded top because another layer linked first, it must send the dev rebase-required on the dev's open task instead of linking, and the dev must rebase before every resubmission.
results.quote: what if we had dev rebase before sending to sanity, and sanity agent actually add to stack.  This would make handling 2 dev complete which were both based on the same <top-X> branch rast through sanity.  the first sanity agent determined PASS would get linked and sent to quality-mgr.  the other that completed sanity as PASS and could not be stacked w/out a rebase was sent back to dev to rebase and re-submit to sanity.  If sanity FAIL, the dev agent would be responsible for rebasing anyhow.
results.context: phase-bj planning 2026-10-18 (second round): Rand's sanity-stack, stack bead and lock rulings (atm-bd-orchestration PR #342, docs/requirements/sanity-stack.md)
results.deterministic_check: two scratch branches cut from the same top both pass sanity: the first is linked and the stack bead's layers has it as top; the second gets one rebase-required send, no link, no ledger write; the hook refuses a PASS close whose vars carry no stack result
